summary: Verified streak counter, theme-unlock-as-reward loop, and catch-block hygiene. All 9 frontend test groups passed end-to-end on the live preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: themes.js hint text for 'slime' has a stray comma: 'nuclear, disaster or scorched' — cosmetic typo, not blocking.

Streak indicator on simulator pages currently re-reads getStats() only on mount and after recordOutcome. If user opens two tabs and earns streak in one, the other tab will not update until refocus — minor edge case, not in scope.
isThemeUnlocked treats Premium (incl. trial) as a master key, so the badge-gating path for inferno/arcade is hard to exercise in normal flows; intentional per request notes.
seed_data_creation: Injected localStorage cot.stats.v1 in-browser only; no server-side seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend base URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. To exercise badge-gated themes, page.evaluate to set localStorage.cot.stats.v1 with desired {unlocked:[...]} BEFORE navigating to /settings; note that a fresh device gets a 3-day premium trial which unlocks all themes, so 'locked + hint' UI only renders for users with no trial/premium. Streak window for cheese on EASY: 90-240 sim-sec; ~6 real-sec under grill hits PERFECT reliably.

verified_checks.theme_badge_gating: With unlocked:['first-toast'] injected, theme-neon disabled=false (clickable). Hint elements only render when locked; not visible here because device has trial-premium (matches request expectation).
